summary.text: P.K. O'Neill is a Republican Nevada Assemblymember for District 40, which covers Carson City, Storey County and part of Washoe County. The legislature says he first served in 2015 and again from 2021, and lists his occupation as retired law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says O'Neill was born in Washington, D.C., in 1951 and holds a B.S. in business management from the University of Nevada, Reno at Lake Tahoe.
Its listing of his career-related credentials includes Nevada and Florida Peace Officer Standards and Training certificates.
O'Neill was first elected to the Assembly in November 2014 and, after a lapse in service, was elected again in November 2020.
His page lists him on the Commerce and Labor, Revenue, and Ways and Means committees in the 2023 and 2025 sessions, and as a member of the Carson Tahoe Hospital Board of Trustees since 2017.
